title: Design: Edit Asset of an internal customer shows the Internal category select
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-18-11b-edit-asset-internal-category.png, iwo-happy-09-09-edit-asset-internal-category.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The asset page opens.

Step 2:

  • After the existing fields, under a divider, the select "Internal category" is shown, empty.
  • Its helper starts with the QuickBooks mark and reads "Categories are mapped to QuickBooks expense accounts. This one is where the asset's internal work orders post. Leave it empty to use the customer's category, General Internal."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R15: “Edit Asset of an internal customer shows, after the existing fields and under a divider, the select "Internal category" (the active Internal categories; empty means the customer's default) with the helper, led by the QuickBooks mark, "Categories are mapped to QuickBooks expense accounts. This one is where the asset's internal work orders post. Leave it empty to use the customer's category, [customer's default]." The field is not shown on assets of other customers, nor while the setting is off. A new internal work order on the asset takes this category (S2-R1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
